== Holotable image sequence ==
The 23 December 2022 and 19 February 2023 PNGs are distinct published images. Each matches the decoded pixels of its later GIF copy. Both latest faces print the same wording and D-E1 mark; their typography and line breaks differ. The source faces are [[:File:Dagobah-D-Captain-Needa-PC-E2-2022-12-23.png|23 December 2022]] and [[:File:Dagobah-D-captainneeda.gif|19 February 2023]].
